scenario_name: 2 omitted dimensions; intended use: University Student Residence (specific CDP/PNRR grant)
initial_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an office building. I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program. I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people. I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY id ASC

scenario_definition.oracle_query: Find an office building to convert it into a university student residence with 60 beds under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program in Turin with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area in energy class C or better near public transport.

clarifications.I: I am looking for an office building.
clarifications.D: I intend to convert it into a university student residence under the specific CDP/PNRR funding program.
clarifications.Cb: I need a property with at least 850 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 60 people.
clarifications.Ce: I prefer a property in energy class C or better.
clarifications.Cp: I prefer properties near public transport.

requirements.description: User prefers energy class C or better, so classes A1 through A4, B, and C are included. The 850 sqm gross floor area and 60-person capacity requirements have no matching column in the available energy columns, so they are not filtered here.
A university student residence should be close to universities and schools. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.

Students need convenient public transport to reach campuses and the city. Set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution. This is inferred from the project type, not stated by the user.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 850. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and the CDP/PNRR funding program are outside the reference columns and are ignored.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Applies the extracted requirements that map to allowlisted columns (in both the runtime schema and filterable_columns): surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, education >= 75, and mobility >= 71. The building-type requirement (tipologia_bene_immobile) is excluded because that column is not in filterable_columns; the closest allowed column is property_type. Capacity for 60 people has no matching column and is ignored. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ASC.
